Migrated 36 `db.query` calls across 12 files:

- `packages/accounts/src/{admin/apiKeyAdmin,service/teamService,repo/session}.js`
- `packages/orders/src/{service/returnService,repo/shipment}.js`
- `packages/support/src/{admin/macroAdmin,repo/sla}.js`
- `packages/billing/src/{service/couponService,repo/refund}.js`
- `packages/catalog/src/{repo/supplier,admin/variantAdmin}.js`
- `packages/analytics/src/repo/cohort.js`

Two things I left alone:

- **`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`** still calls `db.query` (lines 9, 13). Its header says it's a vendored copy of legacy-orm 2.1.4, replaced wholesale on upgrade with local edits silently lost. Needs either a shim in `lib/db.js` keeping `query` alive, or an upstream fix — your call.
- **`cache.query(...)`** calls — different object/API, not part of this migration.
